subject: CS → Eng: Implementation cadence and cost/perf tuning decisions
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ali Noor <ali@clearslate.ai>
Cc: Rachel Park <rachel@clearslate.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CS -> Eng: Clearslate kickoff notes + key tuning asks

Hey team,

Thanks for the call this morning with Clearslate. Quick recap and what I need from Eng to keep the implementation cadence moving: 

Summary from the call
- Primary workload: conversational search with context windows ~2k tokens (average response length ~150 tokens)
- Peak QPS expected: 25 req/s for the first 3 months, hoping to scale to 60 in Q4
- SLA ask from customer: p95 latency < 220ms for first-token in our US region

CS asks for implementation handoff (high priority)
1) Initial quantization profile — Clearslate is sensitive to hallucinations. They prefer a conservative 8-bit profile for safety but want cost estimates for 4-bit vs 8-bit.
2) KV / prefix caching strategy — want guidance on warmup and cache TTL for repeated user sessions (search sessions often hit similar prefixes).
3) Batching policy recommendations — target latency and aggressive batching thresholds (we need a plan for burst protection).
4) Routing fallback policy — prefer primary high-perf model, then fallback to a cheaper quantized variant if capacity constrained; need automated routing rules.

Deliverables requested by customer in 10 business days:
- Quantization recommendation + delta on output quality (short eval plan)
- Batching & cache config for initial rollout (recommended defaults + ramp plan)
- Implementation cadence (who owns what, timeline)

Can you please confirm owners + if Eng can provide the quant profile comparison CSV and a short runbook for cache warmup?

Attachments: meeting recording stub (link in Drive), first-pass implementation cadence doc (attached PDF).

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: implementation_cadence_v1.pdf (summary of proposed milestones, owners)
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ali Noor <ali@clearslate.ai>
Cc: Rachel Park <rachel@clearslate.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CS -> Eng: Clearslate kickoff notes + key tuning asks

Monica — thanks for the clear summary. I’ll take point on the quantization recommendation and the routing policy draft. Karthik, can you pick up the batching/caching config and the runbook for KV warmup?

High-level plan (first pass):
- Quant profiles: engineer two candidate profiles: 
  * QP-conservative-8bit (target: preserve logits w/ minimal quality delta)
  * QP-aggressive-4bit (target: max cost savings; include guardrails)
  We’ll run evaluation on the customer prompt set (Monica to share) and provide token-level latency + quality deltas.
- Batching: start with a dynamic short-window batching policy: 8ms accumulation, max-batch 32 for generation paths for initial rollout. Provide a config that can be toggled per-route.
- KV cache / prefetch: suggest per-session cache with 5-minute TTL for session stability, with explicit prefetch for session re-entry. Provide a warmup guide (sample script to seed cache).
- Routing: policy file will have primary model -> fallback quantized model with an automatic soft-fail after 95% CPU/GPU utilization triggers. Also include manual override for customer SLA exceptions.

Deliverables and owners:
- Quantization CSV + eval outputs: Markus (owner) — due 2026-08-27
- Batching/caching config + KV warmup runbook: Karthik (owner) — due 2026-08-26
- Routing policy draft + small test plan: Markus + Marissa — due 2026-08-26
- On-call handover notes for initial week of rollout: Marissa — due 2026-08-30

Ali, Rachel — does this cadence work for you? We’ll attach the small eval harness and a short doc describing observable regressions to watch for.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Inference Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ali Noor <ali@clearslate.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CS -> Eng: Clearslate kickoff notes + key tuning asks

Thanks Markus — I’ll own the batching and caching deliverables. A few engineering notes to set expectations: 

1) Batching windows and latency tradeoffs- For their p95 target we should favor a small accumulation window (4-8ms). 8ms gives slightly better throughput while holding p95 close to 220ms for first token in our internal sims. We’ll include a per-route override so CS can set latency-first or cost-first.

2) KV cache TTL and prefetch strategy- Per-session TTL of 5 minutes is OK for interactive sessions. For search-like repeated prefixes, we’ll add a pin-for-30min option if they enable session affinity. Also proposed a passive prefetch: on session creation, fetch top-3 likely prefixes (based on recent queries) to warm KV cache. Script attached to run locally against a dev namespace (see quant-profiles-recommendation.csv for test prompts).

3) Quantization test harness- I’ll need the customer prompt set (Monica — please drop into the Drive link) plus a short list of golden responses for hallucination checks. We’ll run A/B inference (8-bit vs 4-bit) across the set and produce a per-prompt quality delta and latency/cost table.

Action items I’m committing to this week:
- Draft batching config + per-route knobs: due 2026-08-24
- KV warmup script + example policy: due 2026-08-24
- Quick local sim results for 8ms vs 4ms windows (internal): due 2026-08-25

Karthik
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: quant-profiles-recommendation.csv (test prompts + profile labels)
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Ali Noor <ali@clearslate.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: CS -> Eng: Clearslate kickoff notes + key tuning asks

Forwarding the agreed owners and timelines to the deployment/on-call team and to Clearslate for transparency.

Marissa — please prepare the on-call runbook and post-deploy checklist (include rollback steps to the unquantized model and a short litmus test for hallucination regressions). Monica — once you share the prompt set I’ll prioritize the quant eval on our runners.

Ali / Rachel — next steps from your side:
- Share the prompt set and 10 golden answers (sensitivity examples) via the Drive link by EOD 8/21.
- Confirm if you prefer session-affinity TTL of 30 minutes for search-heavy users (default is 5 minutes).

We’ll aim to have a short readout in our weekly Friday sync (2026-08-27) with preliminary numbers.

Thanks all — I'll attach the PDFs and the CSV mentioned.

Markus
Director, Inference Engineering
Redwood Inference
